meta.title: fix: #1616: batch requests to the AWS resourcegroupstaggingapi
meta.body_summary: Batches AWS Resource Groups Tagging API requests to reduce sync time from ~23s to ~11.5s, with updated tests and before/after timing evidence.

perf_labels.notes: Codex batched AWS Tagging API calls reducing sync time ~2x; maintainers manually verified timing, approved after addressing API chunk limit feedback.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: The quantitative total of 168,238 changed lines is inflated by multiple master merges; the actual batching change is concentrated in one source file and its test (~100 lines). As a small, targeted performance fix with before/after timing evidence, it fits the small-step fast-turnaround pattern and was merged after addressing review feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: cubic flagged that passing all ~40 resource types to ResourceTypeFilters could exceed the AWS GetResources limit (max 20), suggesting chunking; also noted potential IndexError on malformed ARN. achantavy confirmed chunking was added in a later commit, and jychp considered the ARN check optional.
review_details.performance_claim: Batching API requests reduces AWS Resource Groups Tagging API sync time from ~23s to ~11.5s (2x improvement).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent implemented API batching respecting AWS service limits; required manual addition of chunking logic after bot feedback, and provided manual timing evidence.

detection_detail.code_reading: cubic bot static analysis flagged API limit and ARN parsing issues; maintainer achantavy addressed the chunking concern and jychp reviewed code.
detection_detail.maintainer_manual_test: The PR author provided before/after timing using `time` command; reviewers did not request additional benchmarks.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes explicit test command and before/after timing numbers, but no automated benchmark suite; manual replication is possible.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: cubic flagged two potential correctness issues; the API chunk limit was addressed in a follow-up commit, while the ARN parsing check was considered optional by reviewer jychp.

core_change_summary.description: In cartography/intel/aws/resourcegroupstaggingapi.py, added batching of resource type groups to stay within the AWS GetResources API limit of 20 types per call, using a chunking helper; updated tests in test_resourcegroupstaggingapi.py. Also improved tag grouping helpers for ARN parsing.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Multiple master merges introduced unrelated changes across many files (README, AGENTS.md, new modules, etc.); the core batching change is contained in the two listed files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: improved tag grouping helpers (ARN parsing) and added unit tests.
Multiple merges from master introduced numerous unrelated changes.
Final commit: implemented batching of resource types to comply with AWS API limit.

review_signals.action_taken: Considered optional by reviewer jychp; no change made.
